THE INVERSION (the deeper question Part 1 did not answer)\n\nPart 1 designed the **body** — how a task flows Agent99→PCC1→PCC2/3→PA. It assumed tasks arrive. The engine that does this already has all its organs in the system — they have never been wired into a loop.\n\n---\n\n## VI. THE CHARGE MODEL (the formal busy-condition)\n\nLet `C(t)` = total pheromone charge in the incarnate pipeline at time `t`.\n\n```\nC(t) = Σ charge(pᵢ)   over all pheromones pᵢ in the reservoir\n```\n\n- **Charge source** = `follow-the-fucks-v1` (LIVE, `/api/soul/priority`): `caps_words + exclamations` from `emotional_markers`, plus signal-density (the 86–110/100 the scouts already stamp).\n- **Decay**: positive trails decay fast (use-it-or-lose-it); negative trails decay slow (a dead-end stays a warning longer — per antifragile doctrine, failures are persistent fuel).\n- **Branching factor β** = average child-pheromones deposited per blueprinted node.\n\n**The three regimes:**\n| β | Behavior | Meaning |\n|---|----------|---------|\n| β < 1 | charge decays → terminates | archive exhausted (never, in practice) |\n| β = 1 | steady state | one-in-one-out |\n| β > 1 | charge grows → **needs a ceiling** | the real condition of a deep archive |\n\n**Busy iff `C(t) > 0`. Perpetual iff `β ≥ 1` while unwalked territory exists. Safe iff a homeostat caps `C(t)`.** That homeostat is Section VIII.\n\n---\n\n## VII. THE FIVE PHEROMONE GENERATORS (why the well never runs dry)\n\nThe engine stays fed because blueprinting *produces* more pheromone than it consumes, from five independent sources:\n\n1. **Fractal sub-questions (L80).** Every blueprint that answers one question exposes its children. The \"NOT WALKED\" list is not a footnote — it is the primary fuel injector. Each frontier line is a trail-head.\n2. **Dooku adversarial drift (LIVE, `/api/soul/shadow`, Mistral-7b).** Every blueprint is attacked. Each `drift_indicator` Dooku returns is a *new* pheromone — \"blueprint around this contradiction.\" The swarm is kept busy by its own adversary. -Force | Out-Null }\n256\t\n257\t$dnaCount = 0; $dnaBlueprintCount = 0; $dnaRecords = @()\n258\t\n259\tif ($kiloSession) {\n260\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ⚠ KILO_HOLLOW — DNA extraction skipped (no real transcript)\"\n261\t} else {\n262\t\n263\t$turnSeq    = 0\n264\t$lines      = $rrlText -split \"`n\"\n265\t\n266\t# Parse assistant turns — Claude Code JSONL envelope: role at $obj.message.role\n267\t# Walk content[].type=='text' only — explicitly skip 'thinking' blocks\n268\t$lines | ForEach-Object {\n269\t    $o = $_.Trim() | ConvertFrom-Json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue\n270\t    if (-not $o) { return }\n271\t    $role = if ($o.message) { $o.message.role } else { $o.role }\n272\t    if ($role -ne 'assistant') { return }\n273\t    $content = if ($o.message) { $o.message.content } else { $o.content }\n274\t    $text = if ($content -is [string]) { $content }\n275\t             elseif ($content -is [array]) {\n276\t                 ($content | Where-Object { $_.type -eq 'text' } | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n277\t             }\n278\t    $text = if ($text) { $text.Trim() } else { \"\" }\n279\t    if ($text.Length -lt 10) { [ordered]@{\n283\t        run    = $run\n284\t        seq    = $turnSeq\n285\t        type   = if ($isBlueprint) { \"blueprint\" } else { \"prose\" }\n286\t        chars  = $text.Length\n287\t        text   = $text\n288\t    }\n289\t}\n290\t\n291\t$dnaCount          = $dnaRecords.Count\n292\t$dnaBlueprintCount = ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" }).Count\n293\t\n294\tif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n295\t    $dnaPath = \"$dnaDir\\dna-run$run.json\"\n296\t    $dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $dnaPath -Encoding UTF8\n297\t    Write-Host \"STAGE 3 ✓ DNA: $dnaCount records ($dnaBlueprintCount blueprints) → $dnaPath\"\n298\t} else {\n299\t    Write-Warning \"STAGE 3 ⚠ DNA_GAP — 0 assistant turns extracted from RRL\"\n300\t}\n301\t\n302\t} # end else ($kiloSession)\n303\t```\n304\t\n305\t---\n306\t\n307\t## STAGE 4 — LEDGER (MERKLE — DUAL HASH OVER SOUL + DNA)\n308\t\n309\t```powershell\n310\t# --- Helper Functions ---\n311\tfunction Get-Next-LedgerID {\n312\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n313\t    $existing = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n314\t        ForEach-Object { if ($_.Name -match 'HL-(\\d+)\\.json$') { [int]$matches[1] } }\n315\t    if ($existing) { return ($existing | Measure-Object -Maximum).Maximum + 1 }\n316\t    return 1\n317\t}\n318\tfunction Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash {\n319\t    param([string]$LedgerDir)\n320\t    # Numeric sort — prevents HL-999 > HL-1000 string-sort time-bomb at HL-1000\n321\t    $latest = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $LedgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n322\t        ForEach-Object { [PSCustomObject]@{ N=[int]([regex]::Match($_.Name,'HL-(\\d+)').Groups[1].Value); F=$_.FullName } } |\n323\t        Sort-Object N -Descending | Select-Object -First 1\n324\t    if (-not $latest) { return $null }\n325\t    (Get-Content $latest.F -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).merkle_hash\n326\t}\n327\tfunction Compute-Sha256 {\n328\t    param([string]$InputString)\n329\t    $bytes = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($InputString)\n330\t    $hash  = [System.Security.Cryptography.SHA256]::Create().ComputeHash($bytes)\n331\t    return [System.BitConverter]::ToString($hash) -replace '-', ''\n332\t}\n333\t\n334\tif (-not (Test-Path $ledgerDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $ledgerDir -Force | Out-Null }\n335\t\n336\t# Idempotency: abort if this run already has a sealed HL\n337\t$dupe = Get-ChildItem $ledgerDir -Filter \"HL-*.json\" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue |\n338\t    Where-Object { try { (Get-Content $_.FullName -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json).run -eq $run } catch { $false } }\n339\tif ($dupe) {\n340\t    Write-Error \"IDEMPOTENCY ABORT — run $run already sealed as $($dupe.Name). One run = one HL.\"\n341\t    exit 1\n342\t}\n343\t\n344\t$nextHL     = Get-Next-LedgerID -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n345\t$parentHash = Get-Tail-Ledger-Hash -LedgerDir $ledgerDir\n346\t\n347\t$timestamp = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n348\t\n349\t# Dual hash: soul_hash (user words) + dna_hash (agent words)\n350\t$soulHash = Compute-Sha256 $rrlText\n351\t$dnaHash  = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { Compute-Sha256 ($dnaRecords | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) } else { \"DNA_GAP\" }\n352\t\n353\t$ledgerHash = Compute-Sha256 \"$soulHash|$dnaHash|$parentHash|$timestamp\"\n354\t\n355\t$ledgerEntry = [ordered]@{\n356\t    hl_id          = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n357\t    session_id     = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n358\t    rrl_source     = $rrlPath\n359\t    char_count     = $rrlChars\n360\t    byte_count     = $rrlBytes\n361\t    soul_hash      = $soulHash\n362\t    dna_hash       = $dnaHash\n363\t    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n364\t    merkle_parent  = $parentHash\n365\t    merkle_hash    = $ledgerHash\n366\t    sealed_at      = $timestamp\n367\t    sov100         = $true\n368\t    run            = $run\n369\t}\n370\t\n371\t$ledgerPath = \"$ledgerDir\\HL-$nextHL.json\"\n372\t$ledgerEntry | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $ledgerPath -Encoding UTF8\n373\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 4 ✓ LEDGER: HL-$nextHL → parent HL-$($nextHL-1) | soul_hash=$($soulHash.Substring(0,16))... | dna_hash=$($dnaHash.Substring(0,16))...\"\n374\t```\n375\t\n376\t---\n377\t\n378\t## STAGE 5 — STARMAP (POINTER MAP — ANTI-BLOAT)\n379\t\n380\t```powershell\n381\tif (-not (Test-Path $starmapDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $starmapDir -Force | Out-Null }\n382\t\n383\t$soulTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { \n384\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"prose\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"turn-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n385\t} else { \"\" }\n386\t\n387\t$dnaTurnIds = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n388\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | Select-Object -First 10 | ForEach-Object { \"seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \",\"\n389\t} else { \"\" }\n390\t\n391\t$blueprintLocations = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n392\t    ($dnaRecords | Where-Object { $_.type -eq \"blueprint\" } | ForEach-Object { \"dna-run$run.json:seq-$($_.seq)\" }) -join \"; \"\n393\t} else { \"\" }\n394\t\n395\t$starmap = [ordered]@{\n396\t    run                  = $run\n397\t    rrl_path             = $rrlPath\n398\t    ledger_id            = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n399\t    soul_turn_ids        = $soulTurnIds\n400\t    dna_turn_ids         = $dnaTurnIds\n401\t    blueprint_locations  = $blueprintLocations\n402\t    char_count           = $rrlChars\n403\t    merkle_hash          = $ledgerHash\n404\t    created_at           = $timestamp\n405\t} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4\n406\t\n407\t$starmapPath = \"$starmapDir\\starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n408\t$starmap | Set-Content $starmapPath -Encoding UTF8\n409\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 5 ✓ STARMAP: $starmapPath (pointer map, not content dump)\"\n410\t```\n411\t\n412\t---\n413\t\n414\t## STAGE 6 — SOULKEYS (KEYWORD INDEX — SOUL + DNA, READ-MERGE-WRITE)\n415\t\n416\tExtract keywords over BOTH SOUL (user words) AND DNA (agent blueprints).\n417\tNever `-Append` on JSON. Always read → merge in memory → overwrite.\n418\t\n419\t```powershell\n420\tif (-not (Test-Path $keywordDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $keywordDir -Force | Out-Null }\n421\t\n422\t# Extract terms from both SOUL (RRL user text) and DNA (agent text + blueprints)\n423\t$combinedText = $rrlText\n424\tif ($dnaCount -gt 0) {\n425\t    $combinedText += \"`n\" + ($dnaRecords | ForEach-Object { $_.text }) -join \"`n\"\n426\t}\n427\t\n428\t$words = $combinedText -split '\\s+' | Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 4 } | \n429\t         Where-Object { $_ -notmatch '^(this|that|with|from|have|been|were|they|will|would|could|should|about|there|their|which|what|when|make|like|just|some|more|than|also|very|much|many|into|over|been|being|through|where|after|before|because|being|against|between|without|within|along|follow|coming|think|know|take|come|make|look|want|give|work|time|year|good|some|them|would|could|other|about|which|their|there|first|would|these|those|under|should|after|where|since|still|every|being|great|where|place|found|sound|below|seen|enough|while|both|show|those|taken|might|long|down|part|same|back|call|hand|high|last|next|left|turn|move|live|believe|happen|bring|write|provide|sit|stand|lose|pay|meet|include|continue|set|learn|change|lead|understand|watch|follow|stop|create|speak|read|allow|add|spend|grow|open|walk|win|offer|remember|love|consider|appear|buy|wait|serve|die|send|expect|build|stay|fall|cut|reach|kill|remain|suggest|raise|pass|sell|require|report|decide|pull|develop|return|explain|hope|describe|decide|share|provide|cover|fall|catch|draw|choose|wish|teach|test|wear|supply|shut|hold|push|close|deal|fill|break|support|record|cut|heat|watch|raise|reach|fly|land|cancel|graduate|enroll|register|complete|submit|assign|grade|assess|evaluate|review|approve|reject|confirm|notify|alert|remind|schedule|book|reserve|request|order|purchase|pay|charge|refund|invoice|receipt|transaction|payment|deposit|withdraw|transfer|balance|account|statement|ledger|audit|compliance|regulation|policy|contract|agreement|terms|conditions|liability|warranty|dispute|resolution|arbitration|mediation|escalate|appeal|petition|claim|evidence|document|certificate|attest|verify|validate|authenticate|authorize|authenticate|deprecate|obsolete|retire|decommission|archive|purge|delete|destroy|shred|encrypt|decrypt|cipher|hash|salt|key|cert|token|session|cookie|cache|queue|buffer|stream|socket|pipe|channel|bandwidth|latency|throughput|capacity|quota|limit|threshold|rate|pace|burst|flow|routing|dispatch|deliver|notify|trigger|fire|emit|broadcast|cast|scatter|gather|collect|aggregate|summarize|compress|decompress|encode|decode|serialize|deserialize|parse|tokenize|lemmatize|stem|inflect|conjugate|decline|compare|diff|patch|merge|split|join|union|intersect|subtract|complement|normalize|denormalize|flatten|nest|wrap|unwrap|bundle|unbundle|package|unpackage|container|image|snapshot|backup|restore|migrate|upgrade|downgrade|rollback|revert|reset|refresh|reboot|restart|shutdown|startup|initialize|configure|setup|install|uninstall|deploy|undeploy|provision|deprovision|allocate|deallocate|reserve|release|lock|unlock|acquire|surrender|claim|relinquish|assign|reassign|delegate|proxy|forward|redirect|relay|translate|transform|convert|adapt|evolve|iterate|increment|decrement|advance|retreat|proceed|abort|terminate|kill|cease|halt|pause|resume|continue|persist|persist)$' }\n430\t$wordFreq = $words | Group-Object | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 30\n431\t\n432\t$rfkwPath = \"$keywordDir\\rfkw-run$runPad.txt\"\n433\t$wordFreq | ForEach-Object { \"$($_.Count) | $($_.Name)\" } | Set-Content $rfkwPath -Encoding UTF8\n434\t\n435\t# Update inverted index: READ → MERGE → WRITE (NO APPEND)\n436\t$inverted = if (Test-Path $idxPath) {\n437\t    (Get-Content $idxPath -Raw) | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable\n438\t} else {\n439\t    @{}\n440\t}\n441\t\n442\tforeach ($kw in $wordFreq) {\n443\t    $term = $kw.Name.Trim().ToLower()\n444\t    $weight = [int]$kw.Count\n445\t    if (-not $inverted[$term]) {\n446\t        $inverted[$term] = @()\n447\t    }\n448\t    $entry = @{ run=$run; category=\"soul+key\"; weight=$weight }\n449\t    $already = $false\n450\t    foreach ($e in $inverted[$term]) {\n451\t        if ($e.run -eq $run) { $already = $true; break }\n452\t    }\n453\t    if (-not $already) {\n454\t        # EC-027: COLLISION HANDLER — prevents serialization failure on ConvertTo-Json\n455\t        # When ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable deserializes a single-element array, it may\n456\t        # produce a scalar instead of a collection. += on a scalar corrupts the structure.\n457\t        if ($inverted.ContainsKey($term)) {\n458\t            $existing = $inverted[$term]\n459\t            if ($existing -is [System.Collections.ICollection]) {\n460\t                $existing += $entry\n461\t            } else {\n462\t                $inverted[$term] = @($existing; $entry)\n463\t            }\n464\t        } else {\n465\t            $inverted[$term] = $entry\n466\t        }\n467\t    }\n468\t}\n469\t\n470\t$inverted | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content $idxPath -Encoding UTF8\n471\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 6 ✓ SOULKEYS: $($inverted.Count) terms in index | $rfkwPath\"\n472\t```\n473\t\n474\t---\n475\t\n476\t## STAGE 7 — S2Pipeline (EXECUTION ARTIFACT + VERIFICATION)\n477\t\n478\tOne command runs RRL→SOULKEYS in order, writes the result record, and does not report COMPLETE unless every stage verifies REAL.\n479\t\n480\t```powershell\n481\t# Registry vars (defined here, consumed by STAGE 8 as well)\n482\t$artRegistryDir = \"$repo\\CANON\\ART-REGISTRY\"\n483\t$syncedPieces   = @()\n484\t$rrlFidelity    = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n485\t\n486\t$s2Record = [ordered]@{\n487\t    run_number        = $run\n488\t    executed_at       = (Get-Date -Format 'o')\n489\t    head_sha          = (git rev-parse --short HEAD)\n490\t    rrl_path          = $rrlPath\n491\t    rrl_chars         = $rrlChars\n492\t    rrl_bytes         = $rrlBytes\n493\t    rrl_fidelity      = if ($hasUser -and $hasAssistant) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" }\n494\t    session_id        = \"sov100-roman-run$run\"\n495\t    soul_event_id     = if ($receipt) { $receipt.event_id } else { \"SOUL_GAP\" }\n496\t    soulcount         = if ($receipt -and $receipt.count_after) { $receipt.count_after } else { 0 }\n497\t    soul_level        = if ($receipt) { $receipt.level } else { \"UNKNOWN\" }\n498\t    soul_count_before = if ($receipt) { $receipt.count_before } else { 0 }\n499\t    soul_delta        = if ($receipt) { $receipt.delta } else { 0 }\n500\t    dna_count         = $dnaCount\n501\t    dna_blueprint_count = $dnaBlueprintCount\n502\t    dna_status        = if ($dnaCount -gt 0) { if ($dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0) { \"REAL\" } else { \"HOLLOW\" } } else { \"MISSING\" }\n503\t    ledger_id         = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n504\t    starmap_file      = $starmapPath\n505\t    keyword_file      = $rfkwPath\n506\t    keyword_index     = $idxPath\n507\t    s2pipeline_file   = $s2Path\n508\t    registry_file     = if (Test-Path \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\") { \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\" } else { \"REGISTRY_SYNC_GAP\" }\n509\t    registry_synced   = $syncedPieces.Count\n510\t    result            = if ($kiloSession) { \"KILO_GAP\" }\n511\t                        elseif ($rrlFidelity -eq \"REAL\" -and $dnaBlueprintCount -gt 0 -and\n512\t \"SOUL_GAP_CONTAMINATION_GUARD\" -and\n515\t                            [int]$receipt.delta -gt 0) { \"COMPLETE\" }\n516\t                        else { \"GAP\" }\n517\t}\n518\t\n519\t$s2Record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content $s2Path -Encoding UTF8\n520\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 7 ✓ S2Pipeline: $s2Path | result=$($s2Record.result)\"\n521\t```\n522\t\n523\t**GATE:** Pipeline reports COMPLETE only when RRL is REAL (both speakers) AND DNA is REAL (assistant turns extracted). Any HOLLOW stage = GAP.\n524\t\n525\t---\n526\t\n527\t## STAGE 8 — REGISTRY SYNC (ART ARSENAL × SOULKEYS × STARMAP × LEDGER)\n528\t\n529\tCross-references this run's SOULKEYS against the art-arsenal registry.\n530\tAny piece whose tags intersect the run's top keywords gets tagged with the run, HL ID, starmap pointer, and merkle hash.\n531\tWrites a canonical artifact. Auto-fires every death — no human trigger needed.\n532\t\n533\t```powershell\n534\tif (-not (Test-Path $artRegistryDir)) { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $artRegistryDir -Force | Out-Null }\n535\t\n536\t# 1. Pull this run's keywords from the SOULKEYS stage\n537\t$runKeywords = @()\n538\tif (Test-Path $rfkwPath) {\n539\t    $runKeywords = (Get-Content $rfkwPath -Raw) -split \"`n\" |\n540\t        Where-Object { $_ -match '^\\d+\\s*\\|' } |\n541\t        ForEach-Object { (($_ -split '\\|')[1]).Trim().ToLower() } |\n542\t        Where-Object { $_.Length -gt 2 }\n543\t}\n544\t\n545\t# 2. Write-Warning \"  PATCH failed for $($piece.title): $($_.Exception.Message)\" }\n582\t    }\n583\t}\n584\tif ($artSyncGap) { Write-Host \"  ⚠ REGISTRY_SYNC_GAP — one or more PATCH calls failed; see seal §14\" }\n585\t\n586\t# 4. Write canonical artifact\n587\t$artSyncPath = \"$artRegistryDir\\art-sync-run$runPad.json\"\n588\t[ordered]@{\n589\t    run           = $run\n590\t    ledger_id     = \"HL-$nextHL\"\n591\t    merkle_short  = $merkleShort\n592\t    starmap_file  = \"starmap-run$runPad.json\"\n593\t    keywords_file = \"rfkw-run$run.txt\"\n594\t    keywords_used = $runKeywords\n595\t    pieces_synced = $syncedPieces.Count\n596\t    pieces        = $syncedPieces\n597\t    executed_at   = $timestamp\n598\t} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 | Set-Content $artSyncPath -Encoding UTF8\n599\t\n600\tWrite-Host \"STAGE 8 ✓ REGISTRY SYNC: $($syncedPieces.Count) pieces tagged → $artSyncPath | HL-$nextHL | keywords=$($runKeywords.Count)\"\n601\t```\n602\t\n603\t**Connection law:** Every registry piece that matches a SOULKEY from this run carries the run, HL ID, merkle hash, and starmap pointer in its notes. This makes the art registry a living cross-reference — searchable by run, keyword, ledger entry, or starmap pointer.\n604\t\n605\t**Gap policy:** REGISTRY_SYNC fails gracefully (write `ART_SYNC_GAP`, continue). Never blocks death.\n606\t\n607\t---\n608\t\n609\t## GAP POLICY\n610\t\n611\t| Stage | Irreplaceable? | Failure Action |\n612\t|-------|----------------|----------------|\n613\t| RRL | **YES** | HALT — exit 1.
